arguments.title: Clip Slot Remodel (hole → slot)
arguments.rationale: Switched the Clip panel's circular vent holes to elongated slots. Round holes bridged poorly in PETG and clogged the nozzle on the CR-10 V2; slots print cleanly with the same open area and stiffen the panel along the load axis.
arguments.alternatives: [{"option": "Keep round holes", "reason_rejected": "PETG stringing + nozzle clog (see RCA)"}, {"option": "Larger round holes", "reason_rejected": "weakened the corner clip bosses"}]
